transcript.text: Hello everyone, welcome back to the On Print Shop tutorial series.
In today's video we're going to walk you through a step by step guide on how to create predefined products in On Print Shop.
The predefined products in On Print Shop are the products that don't require any customization or design.
They are ready to sell.
For example, card holder, desk, pal and clock, sports bag, etcetera.
The process for creating a predefined product is the same as the standard product apart from some specific settings.
Let's dive right in.
From the products section of the admin panel, locate and select Predefined Products.
Click on the Add button.
Here, give a name to the product, such as AT Shirt and assign it to a product category.
Now you have a setting called Kit product.
This is to define if the product will only be a predefined product or it can be bought as a kit product only or it can be combined with other predefined products during purchase.
You can check our video on how to create a kit product.
The next is the price defining method.
We already have various tutorial videos explaining these pricing methods and how you can use them in the products.
For predefined products, you can apply fixed quantity and price range based with multiplication or range based without multiplication.
For the T-shirt product, we are selecting a range based on the multiplication method.
Enable the status is Active.
Moving to the configuration section, we have a new setting called Size Active for predefined products.
If you have products that are available in different sizes then you can enable this setting as these products will be readily available to you.
You can manage the stock in the system.
This can be enabled size wise or size with product option.
With none you can disable the stock management to get the understanding of how it is done.
At the later part.
Let's enable this for size.
The rest of the settings are the same as the standard products.
So verify the details and then save.
You can find a new product size tab as we have enabled Size active setting.
Here you can define the size title and enter the width and height as per the sizes you are offering.
Let's enter Small 34 and 26.
Now click on the Add button, enter Medium 3828 and click on the Add button to one more size.
Enter Large 42 and 29.
Then click on Save and continue.
In the Price tab, you can configure the pricing for quantity range for individual sizes and then save the details.
The option rules, meta tag, and gallery tab configuration is the same as the standard product.
So let's move to the Stock tab.
Here you can add the stock for individual sizes of products with the plus icon.
Clicking on this icon will enable you to enter a number to credit the stock with the Commons.
You can even enter the number to debit the product quantity.
To manage an accurate stock, just enter the amount and select Credit or Debit and save.
Similarly, you can manage the stock for other sizes as well.
With the stock setting button, you can choose to get a notification if the stock reaches a particular number.
If you are out of stock for this product but still want to allow your customers to place an order, then enable this setting and save.
You can check the entire history of the stock management using the history button and icon.
If you want to add the stock in bulk, you can do so with the Import Stock button.
Just select the stock type from the drop down.
Select the product from the list and download the template file.
In the next screen you can refer to the help for filling up the data.
Once done, click on the Next button and upload the modified file.
You can check the uploaded data summary and then click on the import button to complete the process.
Moving on to the next is the Print Ready tab.
Here the print ready files for every size need to be uploaded which will be used for the printing.
If you have uploaded any new files here, it will be applicable to all the older and new orders.
The product settings are also the same as the standard products.
On the front store.
You can see the product name with the size and additional option we created.
After all the selections, the customers will have the option to add the product directly to the shopping cart for checkout.
This is it.
You have successfully created a predefined product in your store.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
